title: Small-item and sunglasses storage
summary: Feedback centers on the availability of handy places to store small personal items, with some fragments also pulling in unrelated uses of the word "items."

positive.summary: One positive review asks for a safe, handy spot for sunglasses, indicating storage convenience matters but offering only limited positive evidence.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention buried menu items and disappointment about not receiving branded merchandise, showing this cluster includes both storage-adjacent and unrelated complaints.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe a lack of cabin places to stash change, sunglasses, or other small items, though some fragments are too vague or unrelated to interpret cleanly.

limitations: This cluster mixes small-item storage comments with unrelated mentions of menu items, merchandise, and package items.
Most examples are undetermined, so the sentiment evidence for the core storage issue is limited.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews.
